summary: The claim and proof are correct. Completeness and the original affine law preserve every actual midpoint and its probability band. The two successive midpoint images reduce the maximum number of coordinates equal to two from two to one to zero, and both local estimates bound the same full-band moments. The reflected-pair counting, interpolation, disjoint-band summation, Holder exponents, numerical constants, and degenerate cases, including k=0 and arbitrary affine rank, all check out.
